razonamiento: The architecture diagram shows an internal developer platform (Orion portal) at OLX Autos deployed on AWS. Users initiate environment provisioning requests which resolve via Amazon Route 53 to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). ALB forwards traffic to application pods running on Amazon EC2 Spot instances orchestrated by Amazon EKS. The main application pod triggers Kubernetes jobs for each microservice. The jobs publish state events to Amazon SNS, which fans out to Amazon SQS. When spot interruptions occur, replacement jobs read pending tasks from SQS to resume execution without business disruption.
nombre: OLX Autos - Internal Developer Platform on Amazon EKS and Spot Instances
